This submission compiles the operative text spanning Section 6.01(b)(14)(c) through (e), (15), (16), (17), and (21) as supplied. Sub-clauses 6.01(b)(14)(a) and (b) (pro forma effect lead-ins) and 6.01(b)(18)-(20) are expressly owned by other shards and were not compiled; they are preserved only as dependsOn cross-references.

Clauses (c), (d) and (e) of Section 6.01(b)(14) are treated as three independently-satisfying alternative pathways to the same underlying acquisition-financing debt permission, with (e) expressly conditioned on (c)/(d) unavailability ('solely to the extent not permitted... under clauses (a) through (d)'); this exclusivity is modeled via LIMITED_BY dependsOn edges from r3 to r1/r2 rather than a shared numeric cap (none is stated - (c) and (d) are ratio/categorical gates, not dollar baskets).

The 'Fixed Incremental Amount' definition was retrieved via tool because it is a material formula component of the clause (e) fallback basket; its own nested dependencies (General Lien Basket Reallocated Amount, Available RP Capacity Amount, Incremental Facilities, Incremental Equivalent Debt, Section 6.01(b)(12)(b), Section 6.01(b)(1)(Z)) were not further pursued as they fall outside this shard's assigned unit and would require expanding into an unbounded chain of other baskets.
